messages:
emma: Quick plan: rolling release tonight 23:30 UTC. Services: api v3.3, runtime v1.10, router v2.5.0. Need gating and rollback owners.
raj: I'll own router pin + auto-fallback. Plan: 5% -> 20% -> 60%. Auto-fallback router -> v2.4.x if errors +0.4% abs over 3m.
claire: API gating: p95 < 650ms and 5xx < 0.25% over 5m. Manual rollback for API.
tom: Runtime: v1.10 enables aggressive batching. I added env toggle RUNTIME_BATCH=false to disable. Rollback if kvcache_churn > 15% or OOMs. I'll be oncall.
emma: ops role: ops-bot will execute router auto-fallback; service leads call deploybot for manual rollback.
ops-bot: auto-fallback rules: {"router":{"error_rate_pct":0.4,"window_s":180},"api":{"p95_ms":900,"window_s":300}}. Auto actions will notify #oncall.
deploy-bot: deploybot: starting canary at 23:30 UTC -> router v2.5.0 (5%), api v3.3 (5%), runtime v1.10 (5%). Use `deploybot promote --wave night-6054 --step canary`.
raj: hot-fallback ready (v2.4.3). Will wait 2m after switch before draining.
claire: release notes draft: "night-6054: perf and batching updates; api schema minor changes; console flags off." Posting after go/no-go.
tom: preflight smoke passed in staging. mem delta +2.1%.
emma: typo fixed: emma: monitoring schedule: checks at +8m and +18m. If green, proceed to 20%.
deploy-bot: canary advanced to 20% at 6054321020.
emma: +8m check: api p95 410ms, 5xx 0.06%, router err 0.03%, runtime kvcache 2% 1 proceeding.
raj: promoting to 60% now.
ops-bot: no auto-fallback triggered.
claire: will run client-compat smoke at 60%. If rerank delta > 10%, hold.
emma: final: hold thread for any rollback commands and outcome. If rollback: `deploybot rollback --wave night-6054 --service <svc>` and notify #oncall and #release-notes.
